page.notes: Woodcut initial at the start of the first word: read as B, so "Bertrandus". The line-end mark after "Itaque" is a printer's dash or ornament, not text, and is left out. Ligatures "ct" and "st" are read as ct and st. Possible misreading of "co" for "eo" in "co animo" (marked [?]). The "M.D.LV." date is in small capitals. Show-through and the edge of the neighbouring page at the left margin are not transcribed.
